Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is it from the coverage of this game. The second game of the three-match ODI series between West Indies and Ireland will be played on 11th January, 2022. This clash will begin at 8 pm IST (2.30 pm GMT). But as all of you know, the buildup will begin well in advance so make sure you join us for the same. Till then, cheers and take care!

Kieron Pollard, the victorious skipper of West Indies, says that this win is important, even though they lost the toss, they did well. He adds that the toss is going to play a big factor in the entire series. Mentions that there was a lot of moisture and Ireland used the conditions pretty well. Further adds that they need to rotate the strike while batting. Tells that the partnership with Brooks was needed after losing quick wickets. Concludes by saying that the bowlers did pretty well and he had to go to his best bowlers at the end.

Andy Balbirnie, the skipper of Ireland, says that they fielded well but they could have done better with the ball. Adds that they were not able to pick wickets in the middle overs and that cost them. Tells that with the bat in hand, they were positioned well but himself and Tector were not able to see them through. Mentions that West Indies bowled well in the death overs and credits them for that.

Shamarh Brooks is the Player of the Match for his outstanding knock of 93 runs on debut. He says that he is happy with his performance but a bit disappointed not to score a hundred. On being asked about his transition from red-ball cricket to white-ball cricket, he says it was all about grabbing the opportunity, he enjoyed playing the longer format but he is happy to make his debut in Jamaica. Adds that the pitch was a bit challenging earlier on, but the conditions improved and he enjoyed batting with his captain.
Stay tuned for the presentation.

West Indies bowlers did leak some runs in the first half of the innings after getting an early breakthrough but they managed to come back really well in the contest and picked up wickets at regular intervals after breaking that stand between Tector and Balbirnie. Akeal Hosein was pretty economical as he conceded just 35 runs from his 10 overs and kept things tight. Romario Shepherd and Alzarri Joseph picked up three wickets apiece and they bowled really well at the fag end to seal the game for the hosts. The debutant, Odean Smith also picked up a couple of wickets and overall, it was a good bowling performance from the hosts.

After losing William Porterfield early on in the innings, Ireland did bat really well, thanks to Andy Balbirnie and Andy McBrine who steadied the ship and also pounced on the loose deliveries. However, McBrine walked off the field after suffering a blow on his helmet but then came Harry Tector who had a solid partnership with the Irish skipper, Balbirnie. Both of them got to their fifties but weren't able to convert it into a big one. Once they both perished, things went downhill for the tourists and they completely lost the momentum. George Dockrell and Mark Adair did swing their willow at the end but it was too little too late and Ireland fell short.

A comfortable win in the end for West Indies and they draw first blood in this three-match ODI series. Ireland would be disappointed, as at one stage they were on course to chase down the target but have fallen short in the end.

OUT! TAKEN! What a catch by Nicholas Pooran! Odean Smith serves a short ball, over middle. Josh Little crouches a little and slaps this towards mid-wicket. Nicholas Pooran, runs forward from deep mid-wicket, and dives forward to take an excellent catch.  Odean Smith gets two wickets on his debut. WEST INDIES WIN BY 24 RUNS AND TAKE A 1-0 LEAD IN THE SERIES!

We hope that he is fine and comes out to bat soon. As a result, Harry Tector walks out to bat.
Loopy delivery, outside off. Andy McBrine leans and drives it to long off. A single to end the over.
Quicker this time, flatter, around middle and leg. Andy McBrine flicks it towards deep square leg. Two runs taken.
Another full ball, around middle. Andy McBrine taps it to mid-wicket. Another dot ball.
Full again, tossed up delivery, outside off. Andy McBrine drives it to cover.
FOUR! Perfectly placed! A loopy delivery, full again, around off. Andy McBrine picks up the length, gets down on his knee and sweeps this towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Akeal Hosein goes over the wicket, serves a loopy delivery, very full in length. Andy McBrine looks to drive but gets an inside edge towards mid-wicket. Dot ball to begin with.
Akeal Hosein (3-0-7-1) is back on.
Another length delivery, on the pads. Andy McBrine tucks it towards square leg for a single. He will keep strike for the next over.
Odean Smith goes 'round the wicket, serves a length ball, on middle, at 139 clicks. Andy McBrine, on back foot, blocks it out.

NASTY! Andy McBrine has been struck on his helmet and out comes the physio as a part of the concussion protocol. As a result, the umpires decide to take drinks. Both Andy McBrine and Andy Balbirnie have steadied the ship nicely after losing their veteran, William Porterfield early on the innings. The Irish team would hope that this pair bats deep and takes them closer to the target. West Indies will be keen to chip in with wickets and put the pressure back on the tourists.
Odean Smith bangs it short this time. Andy McBrine misses his pull and gets hit on the helmet. The physio is out there to check on him.
Much fuller this time, around middle and leg. Andy McBrine pushes it towards mid-wicket. No run there.
FOUR! Great execution by Andy McBrine! A length ball, outside off. Andy McBrine steps down the pitch and slaps this past mid off for a boundary.
WIDE! Odean Smith drops it short this time, goes down the leg side again. Andy McBrine goes for the pull and misses. Another wide given
WIDE! Another length ball, down the leg side. Andy McBrine misses his flick and the ball goes back to keeper. Wide called
Good-length delivery, outside off. Andy McBrine stays back and pushes it towards cover.
On a length angling away from off. Andy Balbirnie blocks it out solidly.
Short of a length, outside off. Andy McBrine steers it towards third man for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Andy McBrine defends it to the off side.
Banged into the deck, outside off. Andy McBrine looks to pull but does not get any bat on it.

Top effort from Chase at mid off and he saves a certain boundary! Length ball, outside off. Andy Balbirnie presses forward and drives hard to the left of the mid off fielder. Roston Chase runs across and puts in a dive to stop the ball. The batters can take only a single.
Short ball, outside off. Andy McBrine cuts it to deep cover for a single.

AND AGAIN! Similar kind of delivery to previous one, this came back in late from outside off, Andy Balbirnie stays back to defend but the ball sneaks through his bat. The ball brushes off his pad towards the keeper.
BEATEN! That is a jaffa from the debutant! Length ball, outside off and jagging back in sharply. Andy Balbirnie looks to block but the ball sneaks through his bat and goes to the keeper.
This is on a length, well outside off. Andy Balbirnie shoulders his arms to this one.
Banged into the deck, around leg. Andy McBrine pulls it along the ground towards deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery, outside off. Andy Balbirnie stays back and works it towards third man for a run.
Smith starts with a short ball, outside off. Andy McBrine punches it to deep cover and takes a single.
Odean Smith comes into the attack.
On a length, around off. Andy Balbirnie stays back and blocks it back to the bowler.
This is a back-of-a-length delivery, angling in from outside off. Andy Balbirnie shoulders his arms to this one.
Short of a length, outside off. Andy Balbirnie hangs back and punches it towards the cover fielder.
Good-length ball, around off. Andy McBrine opens the face of his bat and steers it to third man for a run.
Full ball, outside off. Andy Balbirnie presses forward and carves it towards deep cover for a single.
Length ball, nipping back in from off. Andy Balbirnie hangs back and blocks it out.
Fuller in length, outside off. Andy McBrine presses forward and drives it to the cover fielder.
Back of a length, around off. Andy McBrine gets behind the line of the ball and defends it solidly.
Length ball, around middle and leg. Andy McBrine tucks it to the mid-wicket fielder.
Short of a length, just outside off and taking off from a length. Andy McBrine stays back to punch it through the cover region but he misses.
FOUR! Sublime! A half-volley, outside off. Andy McBrine gets low in his crease and drives it handsomely past the cover fielder to bag a boundary.
Good-length ball, around leg. Andy McBrine misses his flick and gets hit on his pad.
Good-length ball, jagging back in a bit from off. Andy Balbirnie turns it to mid-wicket. 6 runs off the over!
Length ball, around leg. Andy McBrine hangs back and pulls it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Good-length delivery, outside off. McBrine looks to pull but it goes off the toe end towards the mid on fielder.
Back of a length, just outside off. Andy McBrine stays back and tucks it to mid-wicket.
Another ball, drifting onto the pads. Andy Balbirnie glances it towards fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Shepherd sprays down leg. Balbirnie clips it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Romario Shepherd comes into the attack.
Another good-length delivery, on the pads. Andy McBrine gets beaten on the pace and gets hit on the pads. Dot to end the over.
WIDE! Alzarri Joseph drops this way too short. Andy McBrine leans forward a tad and lets it go. Wide called for height.
On a length, on middle. Andy McBrine gets an inside edge back onto his pads.
Alzarri Joseph drops it short this time, outside off. Andy McBrine goes for the pull but fails to get any bat on it.
Touch shorter, outside off. Andy McBrine pushes it towards point.
A fuller ball, outside off. Andy McBrine gets a bottom edge towards the first slip fielder.
JAFFA! A length ball, over middle. Andy McBrine looks to defend that but gets beaten as the ball zips past the inside edge.

FOUR! Top shot! Jason Holder overpitches this one, outside off. Andy Balbirnie lunges and drives it through cover for a boundary. Nicholas Pooran chases it down, puts in a dive to stop the ball, but fails to do so and the ball wins.
Shorter length delivery, outside off. Andy Balbirnie blocks it out solidly.
Back of a length, around middle and off. Andy Balbirnie hangs back and defends it out.
On a length, outside off. Andy Balbirnie leaves it alone.
Another length ball, around the off pole. Andy Balbirnie cuts that towards point.
Length ball, outside off. Andy Balbirnie lets that go through to the keeper.
Good-length delivery, on the pads. Andy McBrine gets an inside edge back onto his pads. Dot to end the over.
Too short, around middle and off, at 140 clicks. Andy McBrine looks to pull that but fails to get any bat on it.
Touch fuller, around off. Andy Balbirnie leans and pushes it on the right of mid off. Romario Shepherd dives and does well to keep it to one run.
Swing and a miss! A short ball, wide of off. Andy Balbirnie hangs back and looks to chop this away but gets beaten as the ball moves away a tad bit.
Back of a length, around middle. Andy Balbirnie stays back and defends it out.
Alzarri Joseph begins with a shortish ball, around off. Andy Balbirnie, on the back foot, blocks it watchfully.
Alzarri Joseph comes into the attack.
Fuller, wide of off. Andy Balbirnie pushes it through the outer half of his bat past point for a single.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Andy Balbirnie lets that go through to the keeper.
On a length, nips back in outside off. Andy Balbirnie blocks it out.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Jason Holder serves a fullish delivery, outside off. Andy Balbirnie leans and drives it through cover for a boundary.
Good-length ball, outside off. Andy Balbirnie tries to cut this away on the off side, but gets a bottom edge outside the off pole.
A length ball, outside off. Andy Balbirnie leaves it alone.
Quicker and flatter, on middle. Andy McBrine, on back foot, defends it out.
Akeal Hosein drops it short, outside off. Andy McBrine waits back and chops it past point for a brace.
Fuller this time, outside off. Andy Balbirnie leans and drives it towards cover for a single.
Another shorter one, outside off. Andy Balbirnie hangs back and cuts it and finds the fielder again at point.
Shorter this time, outside off. Andy Balbirnie cuts it to the fielder at cover-point.
Fuller, flighted delivery, on middle. Andy Balbirnie blocks it out solidly.
BEATEN! Good-length ball, angling across the left-hander. Andy McBrine looks to block but it zips past his outside edge.

DROPPED! Shai Hope has put down a regulation catch behind the sticks here! This was a length ball, around off and curling away late. McBrine looks to block but it takes the outside edge and goes to the left of Shai Hope behind the stumps. Hope gets a hand to it but drops it in the end.
Back of a length, around off. Andy McBrine keeps it out.
Good-length ball, around off. McBrine blocks it.
FOUR! This is even better from McBrine! Length ball, angling across the left-hander. McBrine prods and carves it handsomely past the cover fielder to collect another boundary.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! Short ball, outside off. Andy McBrine stays back and cuts it hard past the cover point fielder to bag a boundary.
Leg bye! Flatter ball, drifting onto the pads. Andy McBrine misses his flick and the ball brushes off his blade and goes past the diving leg slip fielder for a leg bye.
Flatter and quicker, on a length, outside off. Andy Balbirnie punches it to deep cover for a single.
A bit short, outside off. Andy Balbirnie cuts but Romario Shepherd at backward point dives and does well to stop the ball.
Flatter ball, shorter in length, outside off. Andy Balbirnie hangs back and punches it to cover.
Flatter and quicker, on a length, around off. Andy Balbirnie pushes it back to the bowler.
Tossed up, outside off. Andy Balbirnie prods and caresses it past the cover fielder for a couple of runs.
Good-length ball, around off. Andy McBrine hangs back and blocks it to the off side.
On a length, outside off. Andy McBrine stays back and leaves it alone.
Short of a length, around middle. Andy McBrine looks to pull but misses and gets hit on his body.
Back of a length, outside off. Andy McBrine cuts it past the point fielder. The fielder gives it a chase and keeps it to two.
Short and wide, outside off. Andy Balbirnie cuts it uppishly over the point fielder for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Andy Balbirnie looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pad.
Flatter ball, on off. Andy McBrine blocks it out.
Andy McBrine walks out to bat at number 3.

Another review! This time William Porterfield reviews an LBW decision. The replay rolls in. No bat involved confirms UltraEdge. Ball Tracker indicates it was clipping the leg stump and it's umpire's call on wickets. William Porterfield will have to walk back as the original decision stands.

OUT! LBW! William Porterfield departs for a duck and West Indies get an early breakthrough! This is a flatter ball, fuller in length, around off. William Porterfield gets down on his knee and looks to reverse sweep but he misses and gets rapped on his pad. Akeal Hosein appeals and the umpire raises his dreaded finger in no time. William Porterfield opts for a review and the Ball Tracker indicates that the ball would have clipped the leg stump. It is umpire's call on wickets and William Porterfield is a goner!

Review-time! West Indies have reviewed an LBW decision! The replay rolls in. UltraEdge confirms no bat. Ball Tracker indicates that was missing wickets. West Indies lose their review and the on-field decision stands.

NOT OUT! William Porterfield SURVIVES! This was a loopy ball, outside off and spinning in sharply. William Porterfield looks to nudge it to the leg side but he misses and gets hit on his pad. Akeal Hosein appeals and the umpire says no. Kieron Pollard opts for a review but the Ball Tracker suggests that the ball would have spun down leg so the on-field stays and West Indies lose a review.
Flatter ball, turning in late. William Porterfield waits for the turn and tucks it to the leg side.
Flatter ball, outside off. Andy Balbirnie eases it to long off for a single. Ireland are underway!
Flatter ball, outside off. Andy Balbirnie looks to cut but it goes off the underedge onto the deck.
Akeal Hosein will bowl from the other end.
Back of a length, around off. William Porterfield defends it to the off side. A maiden over from Holder!
Good-length ball, angling across the batter. William Porterfield leaves it alone.
Good-length ball, on off. William Porterfield blocks it to the off side.
Banged into the deck, around leg. William Porterfield looks to pull but he is too early into his shot and fails to connect it.
On a length, around middle. William Porterfield defends it out.
An appeal for LBW but the umpire says no. Holder starts off with a length ball, angling into the left-hander. William Porterfield misses his flick and gets hit on his pad.
